tags.reproduction_note: Partner B reproduction. Metric MATCHED within a stated tolerance of 0.01 absolute. Partner A reported accuracy ~0.81 / f1_macro ~0.80; this rerun gave accuracy 0.809000 / f1_macro 0.804191 with identical params (n_estimators=10, max_depth=5, seed=42). Dataset verified byte-identical via md5 7396020f8c1ab9425f2814ad058fa8d0 (109640201 bytes). Two deviations from the prescribed protocol were required: (1) dvc pull initially failed [Errno 101] Network is unreachable because the remote pointed at a VirtualBox NAT address (10.0.2.15 / stale 10.45.13.185); resolved after Partner A switched to bridged networking and re-pushed the config, plus a local 'dvc remote modify --local ssh-remote user vboxuser' override. (2) No environment.yml exists in the repository, so mamba env create could not be run; the environment was reconstructed from q4/python_env.yaml. Also noted: the run carries no git_commit tag, and --seed has no default in train.py, so omitting it makes train_test_split non-deterministic.
